主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, submitted to the SEC on February 6, 2012. It includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, linked to Apple Inc. common shares, with a maturity date of February 6, 2014. The filing includes details about the pricing and settlement dates, as well as legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP. The filing is part of the Bank’s shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806).
